items.stem: Sunrise Juices uses cost-plus pricing for low-sugar smoothies. For each unit, materials cost $25.00 and direct labour $22.25. Fixed overheads are $215,000 a year and it expects to sell 6,000 units. It adds a mark-up of 25% to unit cost. (a) Calculate the unit cost. (b) Evaluate the most suitable pricing strategy for Sunrise Juices to use for low-sugar smoothies.
items.answer: (a) $83.08 (b) For: skimming for innovation; penetration for market share; competitive pricing in crowded markets. Against: each has risks; costs must be covered; brand image. Judgement: for Sunrise Juices it depends mainly on how innovative the product is, and also on the level of competition.

items.stem: The market for roasted coffee in Peru was worth $430m in 2024 and $408.5m in 2025. Sales of Andean Coffee were $78.8m in 2024 and $71.7m in 2025. (a) Calculate the market growth rate between 2024 and 2025. (b) Calculate the market share of Andean Coffee in each year. (c) Explain what the results show about the performance of Andean Coffee.
items.answer: (a) −5.0% (b) 2024 18.3%; 2025 17.6% (c) Its market share fell because its sales grew more slowly than the market.

items.stem: Which of the following best defines 'partnership'?
options: A business owned by two or more people who share the risks and profits, usually with unlimited liability.
The owners of a business are not personally liable for its debts; they can lose only the amount they invested.
A business owned and controlled by its members, who share the benefits; each member usually has one vote.
Businesses that provide services to consumers and other businesses, such as retail, banking and tourism.
items.answer: A business owned by two or more people who share the risks and profits, usually with unlimited liability.
items.markingKey: partnership: A business owned by two or more people who share the risks and profits, usually with unlimited liability. [1]

items.stem: Which business term is described here: "A name, symbol or design that identifies a product and distinguishes it from those of competitors."
options: price elasticity of demand (PED)
brand
product life cycle
competitive pricing
items.answer: brand
